author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
You can now add a fully functional AI chatbot directly inside your Canva design — no links, no embeds, no hacks.

In this video, I’ll show you how to add Canva’s first native AI chatbot using Jotform, customize it to match your design, and connect it to things like lead capture, bookings, and automations — all without writing any code.

We’ll walk through:
- Adding the chatbot to a Canva website or published design
- Customizing layout, position, and colors to match your brand
- Training the chatbot using your Canva content
- Connecting advanced actions like forms, bookings, and automations
- Viewing and managing chatbot conversations inside Jotform

This works on Canva websites and any Canva design you publish online, and you can be up and running in minutes.

If you’re building websites or landing pages in Canva, this is one of the easiest ways to add AI-powered interactivity without code.
